## About
Kings Tires & Wheels is a tire shop at 27451 Mission Blvd in Hayward. Folks come in with a bald tire, a slow leak or a nail they picked up on the road, and we look at it, tell you what we see, and walk you through your options.
Customers often mention Ali and Ikram by name. They say the advice is honest, the pricing is clear, and nobody pushes anything you don't need. Several reviewers have trusted us with tires for their Tesla too.
We're rated 5 stars from 481 Google reviews, and a lot of those reviewers say they're sending their family and friends our way.

## Services
- Tire replacement for your Tesla: Reviewers with a Tesla recommend us for replacing their tires.
- Used tires: Good used tires, installed for you, when a full new set isn't what you need.
- Help with a leak: If one of your tires has a leak, bring it in and we'll take a look and answer your questions.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on Tesla cars?
A: Yes. Reviewers say we know how to handle Tesla cars.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Q: How is your pricing?
A: Customers describe our pricing as clear and up front, so you know where you stand before any work starts.
